main_text.l: Iesum Christū.Omnes enim gentes Domine, (inquit Psalmista) quascunque fecisti, venient & adorabunt coram te & glorificabunt nomen tuum: quoniam attenuabit Æternus omnes Deos terræ, & adorabunt eum quisque de loco suo, omnes insulæ gentium: ut benedicantur in semine Abrahami omnes nationes, quū adorabunt in conspectu ejus omnes familiæ Ethnicorum: Tum omnes fines terræ salutem Dei nostri videbunt, in omni loco incensum & oblatione mundam offerentes nomini Domini: nam congregabit omnes gentes & linguas, venientque & videbunt gloriā ejus, omnesque reges terræ confitebuntur Domino, quia audient eloquia oris ejus; eritq; Dominus rex super universam terrā: in die namq; illa erit Deus unus & nomen ejus unū. Hæc quū nondum plane adimpleta fuerint, necessarioq; ad minimum usque apicem hisce postremis seculis perficiēdā sint, merito nobis calcar addent. currentesq; incitabunt ut parte in excolenda nouella Domini vinea habeamus; persuasi nullū holocaustū Deo fore gratius, salute hominum perditorum, nullos suffitus suaviores canticis & hymnis Spiritualibus, ex corde regenitorum ad Sanctum ejus thronum ascendentibus: gaudet enim optimus creator nofter bono creatu-

page.notes: The first word of the page is a fragment continued from the previous page ("Iesum Christū."). "Christū.Omnes" is printed without a space. "nofter" is printed as "nofter". The final word is broken as "creatu-" and continues as "ræ suæ" on the next page, which the catchword shows. Abbreviations (quū, q;, namq;, unū, terrā, gloriā) are kept as printed. Margin references are copied as printed, with long s written as plain s.
